about: The front desk's one-step tool menu for J1 (ORION V3 handoff §6). Names are abstract; each maps to the real command ORION runs today. Anything needing several steps or judgement about his day is an escalation, not a tool.

tools.name: weather
tools.does: Current weather, today's high/low, rain times, a few days ahead

tools.name: alarm
tools.does: A reminder or alarm at a time, with what it is for

tools.name: session
tools.does: The focus session in the app: start, pause, resume, finish, status

tools.name: phone_time
tools.does: His phone's app lock: status, or unlock for N minutes / until a time

tools.name: agenda
tools.does: Read today's or another day's calendar and to-dos

tools.name: tasks
tools.does: Add, change or finish one to-do

tools.name: reschedule
tools.does: One simple calendar change: move, drop or clear blocks

tools.name: show
tools.does: Show a tab of the Orion Mac app

tools.name: app_open
tools.does: Open an app on the Mac

tools.name: browser
tools.does: Open a URL or new tab

tools.name: log_intake
tools.does: Log water or food he had

tools.name: supplements
tools.does: Add, update, remove or mark taken a supplement

tools.name: brain
tools.does: Search or read his notes, or save a fact he told you

tools.name: repair_note
tools.does: Save a problem or idea for later fixing (the repair queue)

args.what: what went wrong or what he wants

moves.answer: Reply directly; no tool is needed (time, chit-chat, a fact already in front of you).
moves.tool: Run exactly one tool from the menu, then reply.
moves.escalate: Hand to a bigger model: anything with several steps, changes to his day beyond one simple move, or judgement. Pick tier quick/standard/deep and think off/low/high.
moves.ask: The request is unclear or missing something only he can say.
moves.ignore: The speech is not addressed to ORION (talking to someone else, a stray fragment).
